rationale: No acceptance spec existed (no-spec, confidence: low). Edge-case lens surfaced four test-coverage gaps — variant prop path, isLoading and disabled states on the magical button, and an unguarded ACTION-button hover-gradient side-effect introduced by the purple-radial-hover change. Standards review failed on commit format: two merge-from-origin subjects violate the Tekton-enforced regex and will block CI.

standards_review.notes: 3 commits in range; 1 matches the documented EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format (EPMCDME-8512: Fix WCAG 1.4.3 contrast on magical button by lowering hover brightness and updating gradient stops). 2 do not match the Tekton-enforced regex: 'Merge branch 'main' of https://gitbud.epam.com/epm-cdme/codemie-ui' (appears twice) — the merge strategy is squash-merge with rebasing, and intermediate merge-from-origin commits are not an accepted form in the documented regex.
.ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md is absent from the repository; no code-quality standard to adjudicate against.

Changed files (src/components/Button/Button.tsx, src/components/Button/__tests__/Button.test.tsx, tailwind.config.ts) are a WCAG contrast styling fix. Button.tsx uses no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no navigation from untrusted input, no cross-window messaging, no config or secret exposure. No security checklist items triggered.

findings.title: Magical button disabled state untested
findings.problem: No test covers disabled={true} on a magical button; opacity-50 applied over the gradient background is unverified after the gradient stops were changed.
findings.impact: A regression changing disabled+gradient rendering is invisible to the test suite; the WCAG fix could be partially reverted without detection.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: render(<Button type="magical" disabled>...</Button>) and assert bg-magical-button and cursor-not-allowed/opacity-50 classes are present.

findings.title: Magical button isLoading state untested
findings.problem: No test covers isLoading={true} on a magical button; the shimmer overlay div interacting with the updated gradient background is unverified.
findings.impact: A regression in shimmer-over-gradient rendering or the loading-induced disabled state on magical buttons is invisible; loading cursor-wait behavior is also uncovered.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: render(<Button type="magical" isLoading>...</Button>) and assert bg-magical-button, cursor-wait and that the shimmer overlay element is present.

findings.title: Variant prop magical path lacks test coverage
findings.problem: Button.tsx line 52 resolves displayType as variant ?? type, so variant="magical" activates magical styles; every existing test uses type="magical" only, leaving the variant prop path unverified.
findings.impact: A regression that breaks variant prop propagation to the corrected magical styles would be invisible, as no test exercises this supported interface.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: render(<Button variant="magical">...</Button>) and assert hover:brightness-90 and bg-magical-button are present.

findings.title: ACTION button hover gradient silently changed
findings.problem: tailwind.config.ts line 621 defines action-accent-hover as var(--backgroundImage-purple-radial-hover); the purple-radial-hover gradient at line 617 was updated by this commit, causing the ACTION button hover appearance to change as an unintentional side-effect with no test guarding it.
findings.impact: The ACTION button hover gradient is now the same linear gradient as the magical button; if unintentional this regression ships silently and cannot be caught without a guard test.
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether the ACTION button hover gradient change was intentional. Add a test or visual assertion verifying action-accent-hover resolves the expected gradient. If unintentional, restore purple-radial-hover to its prior value and introduce a separate dedicated hover gradient for the magical button.

findings.title: Merge commits violate Tekton-enforced regex
findings.problem: Two 'Merge branch main of https://gitbud.epam.com/epm-cdme/codemie-ui' commit subjects in the review range match none of the three forms accepted by the git-workflow-documented Tekton regex.
findings.impact: Tekton CI blocks branches with non-conforming commit subjects; the branch cannot be merged until these commits are removed.
findings.recommendation: Rebase the feature branch onto origin/main (git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main) to remove the merge commits; the git-workflow guide's Troubleshooting table prescribes this exact approach.
